scope: Declares which Defold script value types the binding compiler may model as transparent fixed-layout records and which remain engine-owned. Every transparent entry names the pinned dmSDK declaration the generator must read the layout from; the generator derives sizes, element types, and ordering from those sources and never from this file.

opaqueReasons.retained-engine-handle: The engine owns the value behind a Lua userdata or engine handle table. It has no pinned public byte layout, so a sound typed unit cannot copy it; it needs the retained-handle transport.
opaqueReasons.enum-token-domain: The value is an engine-defined constant domain, not a value record. It needs an explicit enum lowering before a typed unit may carry it.
opaqueReasons.variable-length-value: The value carries a runtime-determined element count, so it has no fixed-capacity typed record.
